query:
SELECT dadosCheque, formaCobranca, estado, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM accounts_receivable 
WHERE dadosCheque IS NOT NULL AND dadosCheque != ''
GROUP BY dadosCheque, formaCobranca, estado
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
